files.module_doc:
Authentication API Functions
Login, register, refresh, logout, and user management.

API Client
Base fetch wrapper with authentication headers, error handling,
and automatic token refresh on 401 responses.

SWR Data Fetching Hooks
React hooks for fetching and caching API data using SWR.

API Module
Public exports for the API client, authentication, and data fetching hooks.
Usage:
import { login, logout, useCurricula, apiRequest } from '@/lib/api';

Token Manager
Token storage with automatic refresh before expiry.
Access tokens are stored in memory only (never localStorage) for security.
Refresh tokens are persisted in localStorage to survive page navigation.
